Lead the development of AI-powered SaaS products within the Heka.ai platforms.

Be a DRI for major architectural initiatives and blueprints; own design docs and migration plans.

Participate in hiring: design interviews, assess candidates, and recommend bias-reduction improvements.

Proven experience delivering AI/ML or Generative AI systems in production environments.

Familiarity with gen Ai frameworks like Lang chain, Google ADK and other Agent development Kits.

Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, microservices, and distributed systems.

Hands-on expertise with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent databases.

Thinks in systems, not just features.

Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions across business use cases.

LLM-based applications

AI agents and orchestration workflows

Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and Generative AI ecosystems.

5 8 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering, with at least 1 2 years in a technical leadership role.

Prompt engineering and optimization

Fine-tuning and inference optimization
Experience applying ML to forecasting, predictive analytics, or time-series related problems as part of broader AI systems.
Proficiency in Python, with strong experience using libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of ML system design, model evaluation, and performance metrics.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage deliverables, and drive projects end-to-end.
